'''Marani''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] partner of a prospector named [[Rondo (Rishi)|Rondo]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Rondo send to Marani several e-mails from [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] where he went to mine [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]], but afterwards he went missing and was presumed dead.
